text: みずに　ゆられてると　ときの　たつのを　わすれるわ…

structure.jp: みずに　ゆられてると
structure.en: when I'm being rocked by the water

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb means 'whenever this happens, that follows'. ゆられてると = 'when I'm being rocked'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the happening into a thing you can forget, see or like. ときの　たつのを　わすれる = 'forget that time is passing'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the casual short form of ている, something going on right now. ゆられてる = 'am being rocked'.
